scope: Independent complete-exterior source and five-view review, not survey or print/engineering certification. No geometry edited.
source_basis: Research handoff and 31-file source manifest; all 15 publicity photos previously personally viewed. Critical source views reopened for this review.

findings: Complete skewed landscape shelter retained, including two rear sloping green wings and continuous high front canopy band; not a cropped bus facade.

Published rooftop outer outline is consistent with modeled roof extent. The interior transverse line marks slope-to-front-band transition; roof slot has a short flat termination consistent with rear photo14 and underside photo7, not a zero-width cut to the outer edge. Exact registration remains estimated.

Front-view left dense stair/tree-aperture wing and right sparse terrace/hanging-net wing match source; reversed ordering in rear view is correct. Both secondary roof apertures and the long open central slot remain visible. Trees omitted without filling the tree hole.
Tiered wood platforms, central steps, front-left ticket/display cabinet and front-right thin counter are retained; under-canopy space remains open and there is no invented enclosed room.

29 load-column axes are specified separately from guard posts; 18 approximate plan-derived positions and 11 rear inferred positions are disclosed. Neither the review nor count proves exact as-built coordinates.

White open mesh guardrail follows official page27 lower photo and publicity photo8. Other publicity photos and official upper photo show bare posts; their chronology is not inferred. Simplified crossed strands preserve open character rather than an opaque fence.

Approximate gray structure, warm deck, green roof, hanging mesh, column wrapping and equipment color placement remain source-consistent. Fine knots, display text and exact turf/roof layers are omitted.
All five final previews personally viewed; complete model is in frame and no mandatory source-bound geometry changes were identified.
required_release_disclosures: All model dimensions, roof hinge proportions, steel/soil thicknesses and hidden joints are approximate, not measured; 153 square metres and 1.2 metre site difference are source context, not a survey scaling guarantee.
Rear 11 column coordinates, terrain boundaries, mesh strand count/tension and simplified roof-terrace geometry are inferred or simplified.
246 x 196 x 2.5 mm base is an invented printing/display connector, not real pavement; terrain is approximate.

2020 project; official meeting dated 2020-02-14, article publication 2020-09-04. EXIF DateTime export metadata on some publicity photos is not DateTimeOriginal; photo capture dates unknown. No 2026 survey/current-condition claim.
White-net variant selected from documented photographs; no unsupported sequence claimed for bare-post images.
Retain separate topology/layer/thin-feature warnings; no actual-print or support-free certification.
limitations: This review does not replace mesh connectivity, exchange format, layer, minimum feature or printer-specific support QA.
Published drawings and perspective photos support topology and approximate proportions, not certified dimensional tolerances.
